blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Monday suspended Sen. Jinggoy Estrada for 90 days due to his plunder case. Estrada’s case stemmed from alleged “intricate mechanism involving illegal budgetary insertions and project allocations” within the Department of Public Works and Highways’ (DPWH) infrastructure portfolio for fiscal year 2025 worth P573 million, according to special prosecutors. The Republic Act No 7080 or the Anti-Plunder Act provides for the preventive suspension of any official facing a plunder case. Associate Justice Zaldy Trespeses, Fifth Division chair, penned the five-page resolution on Estrada’s suspension promulgated on Oct. 12.
